bodyText: Now accepting registration for 2026 programs and courses that meet California Dental HOME BLS/CPR INFECTION CONTROL CORONAL POLISH RADIATION SAFETY MORE ROSEVILLE DENTAL ACADEMY FRONT OFFICE PROGRAM Hands-on experience in a live practice! Sit alongside and participate with a front office staff member while handling day-to-day operations in a dental front office. This 40-hour internship is designed to enhance your skills in our dental assisting program and includes valuable resume and job assistance. Convenient and Flexible Schedule We offer a flexible schedule in our dental assisting program, allowing you to continue with school or work. Classes meet 2 days a week, every Monday, plus 1 assigned internship day. The learning experience includes both in-class work and some homework, and we also provide resume and job assistance to help you succeed in the dental front office. Resume and Job Assistance We will work on updating and modifying your resume and job assistance for interviews in the dental assisting program. Additionally, we have a networking portal where the resumes and student videos will be posted for dental front office positions, allowing offices in the surrounding area to view them. WHAT TO EXPECT DURING THE COURSE! Dental Basics In a dental assisting program, understanding clinical terminology is crucial, especially when exploring oral anatomy and dental arches. Familiarity with numbering systems and charting procedures is essential for those working in a dental front office. Additionally, our program offers resume and job assistance to help graduates secure positions in the field. Dental Systems and Communication In a dental assisting program, you'll learn essential skills such as phone etiquette, patient input, and treatment planning. Knowledge of dental front office practices is crucial for managing recall reports and scheduling appointments effectively. Additionally, understanding HIPAA and HITECH regulations is vital for maintaining patient confidentiality. Our program also offers resume and job assistance to help you secure a position in the dental field. Insurance Required Patient Information for our dental front office includes fee schedules, an insurance breakdown, and details on insurance processing. For those interested in our dental assisting program, we also offer resume and job assistance to help you succeed in your career.
